Bucket row containers govern-record-bucket-{refusals,holds,rule_changes}-rows all present. critical_code_review_comments: RecordBucket now keys the SAMPLE badge off the row's stable identifier (refusal_id/session_id/request_id) rather than array index — this is the right invariant to give the systemic Jest gate a deterministic hook and survives future reorderings of the buckets.

Enumerated rows[] with is_sample flag alongside pre-existing scalar counts (absolute/escalatable/held_for_check for refusals; open/released/confirmed_rejected for holds) is additive-only, so no consumer of the old shape breaks — clean back-compat.

/api/use_data/sessions response does not project is_sample onto session dicts (count=0 via API introspection), but the landing renders 2 badges because SampleBadge on the frontend keys off the session_id prefix (s-sample-*). Not a bug per current spec, but a note: if a future gate wants to compare rendered-badge-count vs API-is_sample-true-count for /use-data, the API will need the flag surfaced explicitly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter17 closed the 3rd-occurrence SAMPLE-marking defect for admin identity on /govern. Regression to preserve: (a) /api/govern/trust_center_record MUST return `rows: [...]` with `is_sample` inside each of refusals/holds/rule_changes buckets — do not regress to scalar-only counts. (b) Frontend RecordBucket component in /app/frontend/src/pages/govern/GovernHomePage.jsx MUST render SampleBadge per row with the testid pattern govern-record-bucket-{bucket}-row-sample-badge-{rowId}. (c) The systemic Jest gate at /app/frontend/src/__tests__/systemic/sample_marking_systemic_gate.test.js is the standing tripwire — any new fixture-capable page-level surface MUST register in it. (d) Consider surfacing is_sample explicitly in /api/use_data/sessions response so the systemic gate can compare rendered count vs API count for that surface too (currently the badge keying works off session_id prefix which is implicit).
rca of the issue: No open issues in iter17. RCA of the iter16 defect (admin blindness on /govern record half) — Owner's independent verification exposed that iter16 GREEN was tested under DPO identity and did not exercise the admin path. Root cause: /api/govern/trust_center_record originally returned scalar-only per-bucket summaries (counts by class), so the frontend RecordBucket had nothing to iterate over and thus no place to attach per-row SAMPLE badges — the visible badges seen for DPO were coming from a different render path (holds surface) not the record buckets. Fix confirmed present in backend/routers/govern.py (rows[] enumeration with is_sample) + GovernHomePage.jsx (RecordBucket rows-list with SampleBadge per row keyed by row id).
